Observing Window Planner

Adjust science and Moon constraints to find contiguous proposal-ready dates. Start with Gault’s 2026–2028 ephemeris, or load a compatible CSV from your computer.

Constraints

Required columns: date, mag, elong, moon_sep, moon_illum, plane. File processing stays in this browser.

Candidate windows

Ephemeris context

Blue: V magnitude (inverted, left axis); gold: solar elongation; coral: Moon separation; green: absolute orbit-plane angle (right axis).

This is a proposal-planning filter, not an observatory schedule. It does not calculate topocentric altitude, airmass, Moon altitude, local horizon, weather, or instrument sensitivity.
